subject: Request: short extension + promo credit to cover sprint hold for FinWave integration
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@finwave.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Integration stall — request for short extension + credits

Hi Ben,

Quick update from our side: the FinWave engineering team hit an unexpected blocker with the S3-compatible connector during our final QA run. The connector fails to authenticate intermittently (see attached error log and screenshot). Our launch sprint is gated on completing the last integration task, which is taking longer than planned.

We love the latency profile from the POC and are very close, but the schedule slip means we’ll need an extra 10 business days to finish the final validation. Would Redwood be willing to extend our sandbox window by two weeks and apply a small promotional credit to cover the additional test traffic while we finish the fix? This will let our product and sales teams get the demos they need next month.

We’re requesting: 1) +14 day sandbox extension, 2) $1,200 promo credit for test tokens, 3) a short mutual action plan so we don’t lose momentum.

Attaching a short MOP draft that outlines the minimal steps for our engineers to validate the fix.

Thanks — appreciate any help here.

Best,
Alex Morgan
Head of Integrations
FinWave Analytics

Attachments: finwave-integration-error-log.txt (text), screenshot-ci-failure.png (image), proposed-mop-shortcut-v1.pdf (pdf)

Ben/Alex/Team — I reviewed the error log and MOP this morning. Looks like the S3 connector is hitting a transient 401 after token refresh under parallel requests; our engineers have seen similar in the field and there’s a simple mitigation we can recommend: add a small exponential backoff + single-threaded refresh window in the client while they patch the token cache.

I can hop on a 20m call at 10:00am PT to walk their engineer through the change. If Alex can share a short snippet of the refresh flow in the call we should be able to get them past this in the session.

Marissa — from Sales Ops side I approve the $1,200 promo for FinWave conditional on documenting expected close plan in HubSpot and setting a one-time expiry for the credit (30 days from issuance). Stephanie — please apply credit once Ben posts the justification and Marissa confirms routing.

Karthik Iyer
